pipeline.description: ETL pipeline for extracting GitHub AI credit usage and loading it into SQL Server

variable.name: Database1ConnStr
variable.description: Connection string for the primary database

variable.name: GITHUB_API_URL
variable.description: Base URL for the GitHub API

variable.name: GITHUB_USER
variable.description: GitHub username for which to fetch AI credit usage

sql.description: Ensure GitHub Copilot billing usage table exists in SQL Server

flow.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[github_copilot_billing_usage]') AND type in (N'U')) BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.github_copilot_billing_usage ( billing_usage_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, period_year INT NOT NULL, period_month INT NOT NULL, user_account NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, product VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, sku VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, model NVARCHAR(150) NULL, unit_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, price_per_unit DECIMAL(18, 6) NOT NULL, gross_quantity DECIMAL(25, 9) NOT NULL, gross_amount DECIMAL(18, 9) NOT NULL, discount_quantity DECIMAL(25, 9) NOT NULL, discount_amount DECIMAL(18, 9) NOT NULL, net_quantity DECIMAL(25, 9) NOT NULL, net_amount DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME() ); END

script.description: Fetch GitHub AI credit usage via Go script

sql.description: Insert URL JSON results into SQL Server table using OPENJSON

flow.sql: INSERT INTO dbo.github_copilot_billing_usage ( period_year, period_month, user_account, product, sku, model, unit_type, price_per_unit, gross_quantity, gross_amount, discount_quantity, discount_amount, net_quantity, net_amount ) SELECT root_data.periodYear, root_data.periodMonth, COALESCE(NULLIF(root_data.userAccount, ''), '{{GITHUB_USER}}') AS user_account, items.[product], items.[sku], items.[model], items.[unitType], items.[pricePerUnit], items.[grossQuantity], items.[grossAmount], items.[discountQuantity], items.[discountAmount], items.[netQuantity], items.[netAmount] FROM OPENJSON('{{GITHUB_BILLING_JSON}}') WITH ( periodYear INT '$.timePeriod.year', periodMonth INT '$.timePeriod.month', userAccount NVARCHAR(100) '$.user', usageItems NVARCHAR(MAX) '$.usageItems' AS JSON ) AS root_data CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(root_data.usageItems) WITH ( [product] VARCHAR(100) '$.product', [sku] VARCHAR(150) '$.sku', [model] NVARCHAR(150) '$.model', [unitType] VARCHAR(50) '$.unitType', [pricePerUnit] DECIMAL(18, 6) '$.pricePerUnit', [grossQuantity] DECIMAL(25, 9) '$.grossQuantity', [grossAmount] DECIMAL(18, 9) '$.grossAmount', [discountQuantity] DECIMAL(25, 9) '$.discountQuantity', [discountAmount] DECIMAL(18, 9) '$.discountAmount', [netQuantity] DECIMAL(25, 9) '$.netQuantity', [netAmount] DECIMAL(18, 4) '$.netAmount' ) AS items;
